beta.nan_policy: NO NaN expected; asserted 0 NaN in the written matrix (runner would otherwise skip NaN in panels and drop loci without finite train values)

cohort.multi_probe_policy: nanmean across probes at the same coordinate (already applied in the prepared file; beta untouched here)

column_order: benchmark universe order (array_cpg_map.parquet raw_cpg_row) restricted to covered loci
id_system: benchmark/TCGA global cpg_idx (MethylProphet); the cohort file uses coordinate-native chrom*1e9+pos (GRCh38, 1-based cytosine); joined on exact (chr,pos), no offset, no tolerance. The new matrix /cpg_idx is the benchmark global cpg_idx so every frozen store matches by id.

locus_protocol.policy: genome-wide seen-only (CLAUDE.md); all universe loci -> train; 849 all-zero-embedding regulatory loci KEPT (identical for all arms)

unmapped_loci.reason: no cohort probe at this exact (chr,pos): locus absent from the GSE40279 450K array content
